item.title: Iran war and rising fuel costs could boost Panama Canal traffic, administrator says
item.description: The Panama Canal's administrator says the war in the Middle East and higher fuel prices make the canal more appealing for shippers. On Thursday, Administrator Ricaurte Vásquez said that when marine fuel costs rise, shorter routes matter more. He says sending cargo through Panama can cut trips by three to 15 days on some routes.
